info.title: IECode CLI
info.description: iecode: TwinCAT 3 engineering from the command line (build, activate, libraries, protection, ADS). The commands that drive TwinCAT need Windows with TwinCAT XAE 4024 or 4026; the file-based commands run on any OS. Not affiliated with Beckhoff Automation GmbH.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
iecode – TwinCAT engineering from the command line: build, activate, libraries, protection.
Commands that drive TwinCAT XAE need Windows; file-based commands work on any OS.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --json
options.description: Machine-readable output: one JSON document on stdout [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show details [default: False]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable colored output [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Confirm questions (scripts and CI) [default: False]

options.name: --pause
options.description: Wait for Enter before exiting (when started by double-click) [default: False]

options.name: --tc
options.description: TwinCAT version: 4024 | 4026 | exact build like 4024.66 | auto (version saved in the project, else default) [default: auto]

options.name: --prog-id

options.name: --timeout

commands.name: info

arguments.name: SOLUTION

commands.description: Bump a library's version, save + install it, and update the projects that use it

options.description: Workspace folder (default: current folder)

options.name: --bump
options.description: major | minor | patch | <version> [default: patch]

options.name: --include-pinned

options.name: --no-save

arguments.name: LIBRARY

commands.description: Relay MCP tool calls from Claude Code to the IECode VS Code window of the working directory: MCP lines on stdin and stdout, until stdin closes (started by Claude Code, see the README)
